entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return. I have a VeloBand Pulse sensor and it's just not reading my heart rate correctly. I've had it for a few weeks now and I'd just like to send it back.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Bob. I can definitely look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, one moment. Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. Looks like it was delivered 25 days ago. You're well within the **90 days** we allow for returns, so that's **no problem** at all. I can process that for you right now.
Oh, wonderful! I was a little worried I had waited too long. So you can just take it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive a prepaid **return label** in your email within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Bob.

You are very welcome. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty and for the trouble with the sensor, I've also added a 15% discount code to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you didn't have to do that! That's very kind. I'll definitely be using that. Thanks again for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been a great help.
Perfect. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
